headline: The Situation in This Sector Is Critical, They Turn to the Government for Help
summary: The Hungarian freight transport sector has reached a critical point, according to NiT Hungary, which is seeking immediate negotiations. Fuel costs are its first request for intervention, alongside road tolls and competitiveness.
why: Road hauliers are a core part of Hungary's logistics chain, so fuel and toll costs feed directly into transport prices and supply-chain margins across the economy.
